# G36 independent alpha-surface oracle

All 120 source frames; stable-envs/transparent-pixel-rays-v1. Straight rays and constant surface alpha; no refraction.
Generated from source evaluated world triangles with independent projected-edge tests.
Depth/ID layers retain objects visible through alpha surfaces; repeated triangles at one object/depth count once.
